theme: 基金·净值与收益率——中欧医疗健康混合A单位/累计净值、年内与年度收益率、中欧基金2025年度收益榜首、华安黄金易ETF近一年回报

initial.question: 我组合里拿了中欧医疗健康混合A，先帮我看下它最新一个交易日的单位净值是多少？
initial.gold_sql: SELECT UNIT_NAV FROM FUND_NETVALUE WHERE FUND_SYMBOL='003095.OF' ORDER BY TRADING_DAY DESC LIMIT 1

feedbacks.question: 它的累计净值呢？顺便一起报一下。
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT ACCU_NAV FROM FUND_NETVALUE WHERE FUND_SYMBOL='003095.OF' ORDER BY TRADING_DAY DESC LIMIT 1

feedbacks.question: 今年以来这只基金整体是赚是亏？按复权净值给我算个收益率出来。
feedbacks.gold_display: +8.69%（截至2026-09-02，按复权累计净值计算，基准为上年末2025-12-31复权净值）
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100*((SELECT RESTORED_ACCU_NAV FROM FUND_NETVALUE WHERE FUND_SYMBOL='003095.OF' ORDER BY TRADING_DAY DESC LIMIT 1)/(SELECT RESTORED_ACCU_NAV FROM FUND_NETVALUE WHERE FUND_SYMBOL='003095.OF' AND TRADING_DAY<'2026-01-01' ORDER BY TRADING_DAY DESC LIMIT 1)-1),2) AS ytd_pct

feedbacks.question: 那2025年一整年下来，它的年度收益率是多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(YIELD*100,2) AS yield_pct FROM FUND_STATISTICS_YEAR WHERE FUND_SYMBOL='003095.OF' AND YEAR=2025

feedbacks.question: 把范围放大点，中欧基金旗下2025年收益率最高的基金是哪只？当年涨了多少？
feedbacks.gold_display: 中欧数字经济混合发起A(018993.OF)，2025年度收益率+143.07%
gold_entities: 中欧数字经济混合发起A
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT s.FUND_SYMBOL, s.FUND_NAME, ROUND(s.YIELD*100,2) AS yield_pct FROM FUND_STATISTICS_YEAR s JOIN FUND_AND_COMPANY_MAPPING c ON s.FUND_SYMBOL=c.FUND_SYMBOL AND c.END_DATE IS NULL WHERE c.COMPANY_ABBR='中欧基金' AND s.YEAR=2025 ORDER BY s.YIELD DESC LIMIT 1

feedbacks.question: 对了，最近想配点黄金，华安黄金易ETF(518880)最近一年涨了多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(RETURN_1Y*100,2) AS ret_1y_pct FROM ETF_PERFORMANCE_DETAIL WHERE FUND_SYMBOL='518880.SH' AND TYPE=1 ORDER BY TRADING_DAY DESC LIMIT 1
